Finding white_wool and blue_terracotta serve as navigation/exploration prerequisites that ensure the agent has surveyed the scene before attempting the crafting task.

Crafting table placed adjacent to blue terracotta supports the dependency graph (finding terracotta leads to discovering the crafting table). Player given 12 cobblestone (enough for 2 stair recipes = 8 stairs) and wooden pickaxe for mining wool.
